correctness.rationale: Avoidance is factorial. A suffix-only generator and an independently implemented whole-word factor-scan generator give identical complete levels through length 42. They yield exactly two length-41 survivors and none at length 42. Direct checks prove the two survivors are complements and both palindromes, and every one-letter extension is forbidden.
